result.instructions: Tools for Booxi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What services does my business offer online, and who performs them?"; "Show me the free places in our group classes next week."; "Find the first open time for a 60-minute haircut this week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Booxi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run booxi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run booxi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run booxi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. booxi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: booxi_get_merchant
tools.title: Get the business
tools.description: Get the business that this Merchant API key belongs to: name, address, contact details, group and tags. Booxi API: GET /merchant.

language.description: Language code for the content, ISO 639-3 recommended (for example eng).

tools.name: booxi_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services that the business offers online, with price, duration and booking method. Only services available online are returned. Booxi API: GET /service.

staffId.description: Only services that this staff member offers.

bookingMethod.description: Only services with this booking method.

keywords.description: Comma-separated keywords to match in the names.

language.description: Language code for the content, ISO 639-3 recommended (for example eng).

offset.description: Number of matching items to skip (default 0).

tools.name: booxi_list_service_categories
tools.title: List service categories
tools.description: List the service categories of the business. Booxi API: GET /serviceCategory.

keywords.description: Comma-separated keywords to match in the names.

language.description: Language code for the content, ISO 639-3 recommended (for example eng).

offset.description: Number of matching items to skip (default 0).

tools.name: booxi_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List the staff members of the business, optionally only those who offer one service. Booxi API: GET /staff.

serviceId.description: Only staff who offer this service.

language.description: Language code for the content, ISO 639-3 recommended (for example eng).

offset.description: Number of matching items to skip (default 0).

tools.name: booxi_list_service_customizations
tools.title: List service customizations
tools.description: List the customizations (price or duration changes) that apply to a service or a staff member. Booxi API: GET /serviceCustomization.

staffId.description: Only customizations for this staff member.

language.description: Language code for the content, ISO 639-3 recommended (for example eng).

offset.description: Number of matching items to skip (default 0).

tools.name: booxi_list_group_events
tools.title: List group events
tools.description: List group events (classes, workshops) that start in a date range, in time order. The range is at most 180 days. Booxi API: GET /groupEvent.

keywords.description: Comma-separated keywords to match in the names.

staffId.description: Only events led by this staff member.

minAvailablePlaces.description: Only events with at least this many free places.

language.description: Language code for the content, ISO 639-3 recommended (for example eng).

offset.description: Number of matching items to skip (default 0).

tools.name: booxi_get_group_event
tools.title: Get a group event
tools.description: Get one group event by id: start, duration, price, location, staff and places. Booxi API: GET /groupEvent/{groupEventId}.

language.description: Language code for the content, ISO 639-3 recommended (for example eng).

tools.name: booxi_get_service_availability
tools.title: Get availability for a service
tools.description: Get the free time slots for one service in a time window, or the next page with a cursor. Booxi API: GET /service/{serviceId}/availability.

from.description: Earliest start, inclusive. Required unless cursor is set.

to.description: Latest start, exclusive. Required unless cursor is set.

staffId.description: Only this staff member. 0 means a client who picks no staff member.

language.description: Language code for the content, ISO 639-3 recommended (for example eng).

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page. When set, leave from, to and every other filter empty.

tools.name: booxi_find_merchant_availability
tools.title: Find availability across services
tools.description: Find the first free slot of each service in a window of at most 31 days, optionally filtered by keyword or booking method. Use the cursor for more results. Booxi API: GET /merchantAvailability.

from.description: Earliest start, inclusive. Required unless cursor is set.

to.description: Latest start, exclusive. Required unless cursor is set.

serviceKeyword.description: Comma-separated keywords to match service names.

serviceBookingMethod.description: Only services with this booking method.

language.description: Language code for the content, ISO 639-3 recommended (for example eng).

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page. When set, leave from, to and every other filter empty.

tools.name: booxi_search_availability
tools.title: Search availability for several services
tools.description: Search free time slots for up to 5 services together, for example a combined appointment with two services. Give a window (from and to) or a cursor. Booxi API: POST /availability/search.

serviceIds.description: 1 to 5 service ids (from booxi_list_services). Required unless cursor is set.

from.description: Start of the search range. Required unless cursor is set.

to.description: End of the search range. Required unless cursor is set.

timeInterval.description: Minutes between offered start times. Overrides the service setting.

merchantId.description: The store id from booxi_get_merchant, sent only when given.

language.description: Language code for the content, ISO 639-3 recommended (for example eng).

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page. When set, leave from, to and every other filter empty.
